intent: A nested JSON inspector with keyboard-accessible disclosures, readable values and bounded rendering for large, deep or circular developer payloads.

layout.direction: Build a focused data reader with a 16px heading, braces icon, indentation guides and 13px mono JSON content. Use 44px disclosure buttons. Let long values wrap and oversized nested documents scroll only inside the labelled, keyboard-focusable JSON region. Keep the demo aligned at the top as its document folds.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.
layout.renderingLimits: At most 100 children per branch, maxDepth (clamped to 1-24), and 500 total entries; circular references show a label. Collapsed descendants do not use the budget. Show a visible limit notice explaining how collapsing earlier branches reveals more entries.

typography.body: 13px mono code with relaxed leading; 16px compact tool heading
typography.heading: font-display or font-serif, 24-36px, tracking -0.035em

motion.entrance: The reader enters with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: Disclosure chevrons turn over 150ms. Keep JSON disclosure semantics and branch focus immediate.
motion.reduced: Listen to live preference changes and immediately finish the reader entry. Remove chevron travel transitions without remounting the document.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: data
props.description: JSON-like data; null and empty arrays remain visible. Circular references display a marker rather than recursing forever.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: Maximum depth, clamped to 1-24. At most 100 children are rendered per branch. Rendering also stops after 500 entries in total.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Keep InspectValue and JsonInspectorProps. Render null, primitive values, empty arrays and empty objects truthfully. Escape keys and values as text.

Track folded branches by their full logical key path, independently of traversal position. Reordering object keys must retain the same collapsed branches and focus. Keep the numbered data-demo paths for the existing default replay.
Scope disclosure IDs to each component instance and encode logical paths into valid IDs. Each aria-controls target exists, and each native button exposes its current expanded state.
Clamp finite maxDepth to 1-24; non-finite values use 12. Render at most 100 children per branch and 500 entries in total. Detect cycles per ancestor chain, so shared acyclic values remain visible.

Collapsed descendants release the render budget. Explain the display limit and let users collapse earlier branches to reveal later entries. This is a reader with local disclosure state, without an editing or save contract.
